title: Your Brain Sees Things That Aren't There
title_full: Your Brain Sees Things That Aren't There #Shorts #facts #didyouknow #science
description:
Do you trust your senses?

Ever woken up seeing things that aren't there? It's a common phenomenon called hypnagogic hallucinations where your brain gets confused during the transition to sleep. These vivid visions are harmless glitches in your neural wiring. Follow for more! #Shorts
